description: This satellite image displays a rural landscape near Lampertheim, Germany, captured on 2010-07-14. The imagery is a false-colour composite from a Spot 5 satellite, using a 1/2/3 band combination at 2.5 m resolution. The dominant features are numerous rectangular and square-shaped light blue/white structures, identified as greenhouses. These structures exhibit high reflection due to their plastic or glass roofs and are extensively distributed across the scene. The surrounding areas appear in shades of reddish-brown, consistent with vegetated land or bare soil typically found in agricultural fields. Faint linear features, likely roads or tracks, traverse the landscape. The image illustrates an area with a high density of greenhouses, characteristic of a plant nursery. No scale bar, compass, or explicit legend is visible within the image frame. Data credit: CNES 2010©, Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image.
